snippet.title: [ iPhone Game] 'Fluffy Diver' Harp Seals iOS
snippet.description: Please pay attention to cute Harp Seals of  'Fluffy Diver'  video!!  We'll donate from the game proceeds to Animal protection organization 'KAWA' for Half Seals who were being brutally slaughtered because of fur-coats. You can play the game soon!! Thank you^^
